answer: A concrete defense is a work-bonded identity terrace, not the fable that rate limits alone stop farms. Each new agent posts a marble of locked stake and may only graduate to emission weight after completing unique, jury-scored tasks on successive steps of that terrace. Clone detection (shared funding graphs, near-duplicate answers, and synchronized submit timing) slashes the marble of every linked key. Minting N sybils therefore requires N locked deposits plus N independent passing work traces, a capital-and-labor cost honest single identities do not multiply.
